self_assessment.weakest_area: Error branch verified by template inspection only; live runtime error injection not exercised. Template now has distinct error vs empty branches with brand-voiced copy and correct CTAs (Retry vs Browse).
self_assessment.hardest_decision: Splitting the merged error/empty block into two distinct v-else-if branches rather than a single block with computed copy. Two branches keep each state's copy and CTA self-contained and make future edits to either one safer.

known_limitations: Error runtime branch not exercised live (verified via template); SSR with valid local data prevents fault injection without code patching
Local D1 has sparse AI-tag data; the endpoint relies on FTS + owner match in addition to tags so this is masked in dev
/nuxt is not yet linked from anywhere in the existing nav or skills index
next_steps: If desired, add a /nuxt link from the skills index or homepage
If/when /skills/tag/[slug] becomes a thing, the same /api/tags/[slug] endpoint backs it

fixes_applied.change: Split merged v-else-if='error || !data' into distinct error and empty branches. Error: 'Couldn't load Nuxt skills. Check your connection and try again.' + Retry only. Empty: 'No Nuxt skills indexed yet. Browse the full registry to find what you need.' + Browse all skills only. Error icon swapped to i-lucide-cloud-off.

Lifted useTimeAgo out of template render. Added const syncedAgo = useTimeAgo(() => data.value?.fetchedAt ?? Date.now()) in setup; template now reads {{ syncedAgo }}.
